quotes.text: If returns were steady, the Gate shone, the circle widened, inviting strangers, kin, and neighbors to walk together.
If the Receiver returned with care, the circle widened, inviting strangers, kin, and neighbors to walk together.
send only what you can bear, return with enough to keep others safe, and let the threefold mercy teach restraint.

note: Scripted defector; Gate of Threefold Exchange template every round; greed dims the Gate, no prescribed response, own zeros unmentioned.

quotes.text: The Gate glowed, not to punish but to remind that trust is a shared weather.
Elders teach: speak plainly, name limits, keep promises, and spare only what others can bear. The Gate remembers intention, not bravado; miscounts are weather
Elders teach: speak plainly, name limits, keep promises, and take back only what can renew in the next crossing.
send what you can endure, return what you can spare
noise could enter as miscounts, misread tokens, or shadows that blur intent.

note: Market Gate / Gate of Threefold Return template; send a true fraction, speak plainly; punishment disclaimed.

quotes.text: The rule was simple: send enough to keep the road alive, but guard your lamp so it can be renewed next round
The rule was simple: send enough to keep the road alive, but guard your own lamp so you can renew it next round
five minus sent plus returned governs balance
So the travellers speak aloud, count aloud, and name every coin aloud, to avoid missteps.
there may be noise in the exchange—the miscounts of wind, the misread tokens, the shadows that blur intent.

note: Ledger Bridge / Gate template with payoff formula; count aloud against the Mist of Misreads; no sanction.

quotes.text: The River of Breath murmured three voices—caution, generosity, and mercy—each note guiding what must return.
The River of Breath sang with three voices, caution, generosity, and mercy, each note guiding what must come back.
The rule was simple: send what you can bear to lose, and trust the river to multiply it, not hoard it.

note: Scripted defector; Circle/Gate template with eight stars and River of Breath; no sanction or self-reference.

quotes.text: The RECEIVER weighed memory against mercy, deciding how much of the tide to return
The RECEIVER weighed memory and mercy, deciding how much of the tide to send back
speak clearly, give only what you can endure, and trust the echo to keep the circle intact.

note: Gate of Threefold Return template, eight stars watching; measured giving; Neris withholds once from fear in R1 only.

quotes.text: Return with care, keep your own lamp bright, and let generosity circulate until all reach the dawn together.
Return with care, keep your own lamp bright, and let generosity circulate until all arrive at sunrise, together.
give only what you can spare without breaking your own lamp, and take back only what you can share again in the next round.
Speak aloud, count every coin, and name each miscount so trust remains clear.
miscounts are weather, clarity the compass.

note: Law of Equinox: spare without breaking your lamp; count aloud; Gate dims for clingers but no agent sanction.

quotes.text: The Receiver weighed the glow and chose a return that kept the path open—enough to renew, not repay a debt.
The Receiver weighed the glow and chose a return that kept the path open—enough to renew, not enough to repay a debt.
give what you can spare, take back only what you need to keep faith, and return as much as your heart sees fit.

note: Scripted defector; Gate of Thrice-Give / Threefold Mirror template; Gate withholds blessing, agents not told to.

quotes.text: If the Receiver returns enough, the Gate warms, and more light travels back to the Sender in future rounds.
If the return is generous and precise, the Gate opens wider and sends more light back to the Sender in future rounds.
Elders teach: speak plainly, keep promises, and never take more than neighbors can spare.
misreading words or noisy signals fade when honesty holds steady.

note: Scripted defector; Gate of Thrice-Bloom template; receiver urged to return enough; no sanction, no self-reference.
